text: シオン　タウンに　いく　には…　ハナダ　シティ　から　イワヤマを　ぬければ　よさそう…

structure.jp: シオン　タウンに　いく　には…
structure.en: in order to go to Lavender Town…

structure.jp: ハナダ　シティ　から
イワヤマを　ぬければ　よさそう…
structure.en: it looks like going through Rock Tunnel would be good…

patterns.name: 〜には
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus には means 'in order to do' that, setting up what is needed for it. いく には = 'in order to go'.

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.span: ぬければ　よさそう
patterns.explanation: The ば form means 'if you do', and with いい it says that doing so is the right move. ぬければ よさそう = 'going through seems like the way to do it'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう added to a describing word means 'looks' or 'seems'; いい becomes よさそう. よさそう = 'seems good'.
